name: Nigerian Breweries
source: CRON 2026-11-21: 9M 2026 column read from the issuer printed page 1 of 48214_NIGERIAN_BREWERIES_PLC-_QUARTER_3_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_OCTOBER_2026.pdf in the NGX doclib filing library, in thousands of naira stored as absolute naira. Printed and stored: net revenue 1,102,659,200; cost of sales 624,759,375; gross profit 477,899,825; other income 2,890,682; selling and distribution expenses 240,937,581; administrative expenses 59,851,052; net charge of expected credit loss 820,473; results from operating activities 179,181,401; finance income 3,698,523; finance costs 11,198,057; net finance costs 7,499,534; profit before tax 171,681,867; income tax expense 57,582,856; profit after tax 114,099,011; earnings per share 368 kobo stored as 3.68 naira. Ties: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit and profit before tax less income tax equals net profit. Group column, year to date. Operating Expenses carries selling and distribution plus administrative expenses plus the credit loss charge, so gross profit less operating expenses does not equal results from operating activities here because that line also carries other income of 2,890,682. Document: https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/48214_NIGERIAN_BREWERIES_PLC-_QUARTER_3_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_OCTOBER_2026.pdf | earlier: Nigerian Breweries Plc annual report and accounts for the year ended 31 December 2025 (audited, Group/consolidated column), statements of profit or loss page 36 and the Group Five-Year Financial Summary page 115. Currency NGN thousands. FY2025 and FY2024 are the audited consolidated columns; FY2023 to FY2021 are the audited Group five-year summary, which is why Revenue, Operating Profit (EBIT), Profit Before Tax and Net Profit carry all five years while the lines only printed for two years are e
